integrity_notes: The proof is self-contained via finite-dimensional flag counts. Reproducible small-field tests support, but do not replace, the general symbolic argument. No independent audit is represented.
scientific_limitations: Counts ordered matrices, not joint similarity classes or Jordan types. Classical incidence-counting identities and the structural relation between products XY and YX are not claimed as new. An earlier equivalently parameterized formula remains a bibliographic possibility.
title: Bidirectional product-rank fibers of square-zero matrix pairs
